dogecoin.text: "Watching politicians discuss crypto is like watching a boomer try to set up a TikTok account. Meanwhile, Elon’s tweeting about taking Dogecoin to Mars, and I’m just here wondering if Bitcoin will ever be as stable as my New Year's resolution. #TechTangles"

"Elon Musk is like Bitcoin: volatile, always in the headlines, and everyone's still trying to understand how he really works. Meanwhile, politicians are more like Dogecoin: started as a joke, yet somehow still in the mix. 😅 #TechTalk"
